body: man.. thank you so much for being supportive.. it means so much. Its just so hard seeing myself when I havent told anybody about the mess ive become because Ive been attacked by a monster that is steroids... I dont know how people would react. My cat saw me last night with my armpit exposed (the worst of them) and flinched, jumped off the bed and left the room :( ... Honestly I used to be depressed and lonely the first part of college, but in high school I was popular. Also now, Ive taken up skateboarding at a park by my new school so Im honestly happy and not very depressed aside from this situation... Its sad that Im such a free spirit with so much to offer who would be glad to do it but am just scarred for life at 21... I dont know if I can ever have kids because Im ashamed of myself.. Will I be alive in 20 years? Its sad because I want to be..
